notes:
Contract: entity=project, mode=read, single required path param project_id (INTEGER, not the PR-NNN identifier). No body/json_path — arguments go entirely in query. Query params: q[created_at] and q[closed_at] (relative-window tokens like '3_month'), q[owner], filter_details. Guidance documents a filter trap: q[closed_at] is the meaningful key but is only honoured when q[created_at] is absent or 'all_time' (created_at otherwise wins), and sending any other q key without an explicit q[created_at] silently defaults closed_at to a rewritten '1_year' window. Declared 200 schema: {data: [{name, data: [int...], result_status: {id, field_value, internal_name, field_name, colour}}], date_list: [string...], empty_data: boolean}. Each series in `data` aligns positionally with `date_list`; the numbers carry no month key of their own.

Invoked with project_id=379335744 (the fixture project, from the pool), q[created_at]=all_time (so closed_at is honoured, per guidance) and q[closed_at]=5_year, which produced date_list buckets H2 2021..H2 2026 (half-year buckets), correctly spanning 2026-09. Response was 200 with empty_data:true and data:[] -- zero closed test runs found for this project in that window. Widened to q[closed_at]=10_year as a second, non-erroring check (buckets H2 2016..H2 2026, still spanning 2026-09) and got the identical empty result, ruling out a too-narrow window as the cause: the fixture project (379335744 / PR-2005) appears to have no CLOSED test runs at all in preprod, regardless of window width. Both calls were clean 200s -- no error/retry cycle was needed, so `attempts` is empty; the second call is recorded here as evidence rather than as a fix-and-retry.

Per the empty-case rule: an empty data array and empty_data:true prove nothing about the declared item shape (`name`, per-period `data` counts, `result_status` object with id/field_value/internal_name/field_name/colour) -- that shape was never exercised. The declared 200 envelope itself (data/date_list/empty_data keys) IS confirmed present and correctly typed, but the per-status split this capability exists to test (status-keyed series varying with the data) was not observed. Verdict is UNVERIFIED, not PASS: prerequisites (at least one CLOSED test run on the fixture project, within a window covering its close date) were unavailable, and this is a read-only round so no run could be closed to create one. To move this to PASS or DRIFT, a run on project 379335744 needs an existing CLOSED status with a closed_at date inside a queried window -- none was found across a 5-year and a 10-year lookback.
